definitions.gloss: stamping a seal; affixing a seal
definitions.explanation: the act of pressing a personal seal (hanko) onto a document

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{捺印|なついん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To stamp a seal on a document.

examples.japanese: ⟦{署名|しょめい}→署名：03682_shomei⟧{捺印|なついん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Please sign and stamp your seal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{捺印|なついん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{実印|じついん}→実印：07490_jitsuin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: A registered seal is required for stamping on contracts.

notes:
{捺印|なついん} refers specifically to the act of stamping a seal on documents.

WRITING:
- {捺|なつ} (press, stamp)
- {印|いん} (seal, stamp)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, personal seals (⟦{印鑑|いんかん}→印鑑：05290_inkan⟧/⟦{判子|はんこ}→判子：00089_hanko⟧) are used instead of or in addition to signatures for official documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{署名|しょめい}→署名：03682_shomei⟧{捺印|なついん} (signature and seal)
- ⟦{記名|きめい}→記名：14862_kimei⟧{捺印|なついん} (printed name and seal)
- {捺印|なついん}⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧ (seal stamp field)

TYPES OF SEALS:
- ⟦{実印|じついん}→実印：07490_jitsuin⟧ (registered seal - for important documents)
- ⟦{認印|みとめいん}→認印：07489_mitomein⟧/{認|みと}め{印|いん} (personal seal - for everyday use)
- ⟦{銀行印|ぎんこういん}→銀行印：27357_ginkouin⟧ (bank seal)

USAGE:
- {捺印|なついん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to affix a seal - suru verb)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{押印|おういん}→押印：07488_ouin⟧ (stamping a seal - synonym)
- ⟦{判子|はんこ}→判子：00089_hanko⟧/⟦{印鑑|いんかん}→印鑑：05290_inkan⟧ (personal seal)
